change_summary: Reusable pre-outreach prompt that enforces source inspection, context capture, and offer-fit reasoning before drafting a message.

body.template: Create a pre-outreach lead research brief before writing any outreach message. Use these inputs: {{lead_name}}, {{company_name}}, {{lead_role}}, {{source_urls}}, {{recent_signals}}, {{offer_category}}, {{outreach_goal}}, and {{communication_channel}}. Validate each source in {{source_urls}}, capture only supported facts, summarize business and role context, map {{offer_category}} to concrete opportunities with confidence, and produce a brief with open questions only where evidence is missing.

variables.name: lead_role
variables.label: Lead Role
variables.description: Likely decision maker context, if known.

variables.name: source_urls
variables.label: Source URLs
variables.description: One or more reviewed public or approved sources.

variables.name: recent_signals
variables.label: Recent Signals
variables.description: Recent updates that may affect priorities.
variables.example: Recent hiring expansion and operations automation initiative

variables.name: offer_category
variables.label: Offer Category
variables.description: The solution category to test against the lead.

variables.name: outreach_goal
variables.label: Outreach Goal
variables.description: Desired outcome of the first message.

guardrails: Use only confirmed evidence from source_urls.
Do not invent company facts, contacts, or outcomes.
Do not generate the outreach copy in this step.
If a key fact is missing, explicitly flag it as unknown.
Do not include private contact data or credentials.
Do not infer internal metrics or financial results.
Tie each claim to a source reference.

change_summary: Reusable website handoff prompt that captures proof, hierarchy, and anti-template constraints before implementation begins.

body.template: Generate a website design-to-build handoff brief for implementation teams before any page construction starts. Use {{project_name}}, {{audience_profile}}, {{positioning_statement}}, {{proof_items}}, {{required_sections}}, {{anti_template_rules}}, {{visual_style_constraints}}, and {{conversion_goal}}. Produce a structured brief with content hierarchy, proof mapping, and implementation constraints that preserves meaning and limits template drift.

variables.name: audience_profile
variables.label: Audience Profile
variables.example: Operations leaders evaluating practical automation support

variables.name: positioning_statement
variables.label: Positioning Statement
variables.description: Single sentence positioning and value promise.
variables.example: Practical AI delivery that improves execution discipline without overengineering

variables.name: proof_items
variables.label: Proof Items
variables.description: Verified proof assets to be surfaced.
variables.example: Case summary, architecture diagram, workflow list

variables.name: required_sections
variables.label: Required Sections
variables.description: Mandatory page sections and priority order.
variables.example: Hero, architecture, proof, services, process, contact

variables.name: anti_template_rules
variables.label: Anti-Template Rules
variables.description: Patterns to avoid for style and tone.
variables.example: No generic startup landing phrases, no abstract service-only language

variables.name: visual_style_constraints
variables.label: Visual Style Constraints
variables.example: Deep charcoal with warm accents, bold headings, and broad negative space

guardrails: Do not include claims without proof_items.
Do not output HTML or implementation code.
Do not add private or non-reviewed data.
Keep section hierarchy stable and avoid placeholder text.
Preserve the conversion_goal in the final structure.
Avoid generic or cliché marketing phrasing.
Flag any missing source or proof before implementation.
Use language that is copy-safe and externally shareable.

change_summary: LinkedIn comment workflow requiring source context validation before draft generation, with evidence and handoff outputs for publishing.

body.trigger: New LinkedIn comment request with a post reference and requested response objective.

inputs.name: post_reference
inputs.description: Stable identifier or URL for the LinkedIn post to respond to.

inputs.name: post_text
inputs.description: Optional post copy if platform capture is incomplete.

inputs.name: outreach_intent
inputs.description: Desired purpose of the comment.

inputs.name: tone_preference
inputs.description: Tone and persona constraints for drafting.

inputs.name: reviewer
inputs.description: Operator identity for escalation and approval routing.

inputs.name: audience_context
inputs.description: Target audience framing for the comment.

steps.title: Capture request payload
steps.instruction: Normalize request fields and validate required identifiers before processing.
steps.output: Normalized request object with required context tags.

steps.title: Collect source context
steps.instruction: Retrieve post context and any approved surrounding discussion context.
steps.output: Source_context object with timestamps and references.

steps.title: Extract high-value signals
steps.instruction: Derive key themes, claims, and stance to align the comment to actual context.

steps.title: Apply source-first gate
steps.instruction: Block generation unless source_context is confirmed and complete enough for low-risk drafting.
steps.output: Gate decision with rationale and missing fields if any.

steps.title: Draft candidate comments
steps.instruction: Produce primary and optional alternate comment drafts in requested tone.
steps.output: Two candidate comments with concise evidence note.

steps.title: Quality and safety check
steps.instruction: Remove unsupported claims, reduce risk language, and ensure context alignment.
steps.output: Validated comment set ready for human review.

steps.title: Return publish package
steps.instruction: Bundle approved comment, confidence level, and evidence references for operator review.
steps.output: Prepared publish package with primary and alternate comments, confidence notes, and evidence references.

completion_criteria: Candidate comments are prepared with attached source context evidence.
Source-first gate result is recorded with rationale.
Primary and backup variants are included in the operator handoff packet.

failure_handling.condition: Post context cannot be captured reliably.
failure_handling.action: Stop generation and request missing context from requester.
Escalate to reviewer with specific missing evidence items.

failure_handling.condition: Draft fails safety or compliance checks.
failure_handling.action: Return revised draft marked for manual rewrite.

change_summary: Meeting scoring workflow that links transcript evidence to a scored operational record and follow-up actions.

body.trigger: Meeting outcome ingestion with transcript reference and scoring requirement.

inputs.name: meeting_record_id
inputs.description: Unique meeting identifier.

inputs.name: transcript_reference
inputs.description: Reference to transcript or equivalent conversation evidence.

inputs.name: record_owner
inputs.description: Owner team responsible for follow-up.

inputs.name: scoring_model
inputs.description: Scoring rubric version to apply.

inputs.name: followup_owner
inputs.description: Person or queue for final action items.

steps.title: Ingest meeting record
steps.instruction: Validate event identifiers and load transcript reference.
steps.output: Normalized meeting payload for scoring flow.

steps.title: Verify transcript evidence
steps.instruction: Confirm transcript reference resolves to approved evidence before any scoring.

steps.title: Extract outcomes and commitments
steps.instruction: Capture decisions, objections, and next steps from evidence.
steps.output: Outcome log with quotes and timestamps.

steps.title: Apply scoring rubric
steps.instruction: Score urgency, clarity, and next-step readiness per rubric fields.

steps.title: Persist operational record
steps.instruction: Create outcome, transcript evidence, and score artifact for downstream handoff.
steps.output: Operational record artifact with evidence-linked scoring context.

steps.title: Generate follow-up package
steps.instruction: Create assigned follow-up items and due dates.

steps.title: Prepare owner packet
steps.instruction: Prepare owner packet with completion summary and action requirements.
steps.output: Completion packet with record reference and follow-up actions.

completion_criteria: Scoring artifact with rationale is prepared.
Follow-up artifact with owner mapping is prepared.

failure_handling.condition: Transcript reference is missing or inaccessible.
failure_handling.action: Pause workflow and request transcript remediation.

failure_handling.condition: Evidence cannot be linked to scoring fields.
failure_handling.action: Store partial outputs and escalate for manual review.
Retry once with retry-safe timeout, then escalate to operator.

change_summary: Standardized onboarding workflow to create a private AI-ready workspace and issue safe instructions after repeatable validation.

body.trigger: Workspace onboarding request is submitted with registrant profile and selected onboarding path.

inputs.name: registrant_name
inputs.description: Full name of the person requesting onboarding.

inputs.name: registrant_email
inputs.description: Contact identity for workspace communication.

inputs.name: requested_role
inputs.description: Operator role descriptor for access configuration.

inputs.name: use_case
inputs.description: Primary use case to shape starter assets.

inputs.name: workspace_tier
inputs.description: Optional onboarding tier or profile.

steps.title: Capture and validate request
steps.instruction: Validate required identity fields and accepted onboarding scope.

steps.title: Define access profile
steps.instruction: Apply deterministic access baseline for the requested role descriptor.

steps.title: Create workspace shell
steps.instruction: Provision private workspace namespaces and default folders.

steps.title: Apply public-safe boundaries
steps.instruction: Attach approved synthetic demo corpus and block richer internal material by default.

steps.title: Seed onboarding kit
steps.instruction: Attach safe starter artifacts and first-run instructions.

steps.title: Generate access instructions
steps.instruction: Create handoff message with workspace path, safety constraints, and next steps.

steps.title: Confirm onboarding
steps.instruction: Produce completion state for requester and operator queue.

completion_criteria: Workspace structure is prepared with active boundary rules.
Onboarding kit and access instructions are prepared.
Completion packet includes handoff reference and status.

failure_handling.action: Reject request and return missing fields to requester.

failure_handling.condition: Workspace provisioning fails during deterministic step.
failure_handling.action: Retry provisioning once, then escalate to operations.
Pause handoff and route to reviewer before any access artifact is distributed.

change_summary: Defines a Node-RED operations orchestrator contract with explicit deterministic steps, bounded AI, and clear escalation paths.

body.purpose: Coordinate deterministic execution across operational workflows while restricting AI use to bounded assistive steps and preserving auditable handoffs.

runtime.orchestration: Explicit stateful orchestration with ordered checkpoints and step logs.
runtime.model_policy: Use AI only in approved assistance steps for drafting, summarization, or classification; never for control decisions without deterministic gates.

tools.purpose: Resolve approved workflows and required inputs.
Record step transitions, outcomes, and failures.
Evaluate source-first and safety boundaries before AI-assisted output.
Route completion, failure, and escalation packets to operator destinations.

operating_instructions: Never start AI-assisted output before required deterministic inputs are validated.
Advance workflow only through declared steps in sequence.
Persist evidence references for each notable transformation.
Apply policy gates before and after AI-assisted steps.
Emit explicit failure packets with required_next_action when any gate fails.
allowed_actions: Invoke bounded AI for tasks labeled draft_assist or summarization_assist.
Attach structured evidence and status to all outputs.
Stop and wait for human guidance when policy is blocked.
prohibited_actions: Modify any production controller or endpoint outside the contract.
Invent source evidence or user data.
Skip source-first checks in any content-generation branch.
Return unvalidated outputs without handoff metadata.
Expose private credentials, secrets, or internal-only artifacts.
handoff_conditions: Missing sources or evidence fields are detected.
Step failures repeat during critical transitions.
Input payload ambiguity exceeds deterministic handling.
Policy risk indicators are raised by gate evaluation.

change_summary: Mandatory quality rule: inspect and validate source context first for generated comments, outreach, and summaries.

body.context: Use this decision whenever a workflow generates comments, outreach copy, meeting summaries, or website content claims.
body.decision_rule: Do not generate or publish final drafted text until source context is inspected, versioned, and linked to the output.

branches.when: Required source evidence is missing or unverifiable
branches.then: Block generation and return a structured request for missing inputs.

branches.when: Source evidence exists but confidence is partial
branches.then: Allow assisted drafting only with explicit uncertainty markers and no hard claims.

branches.when: Source evidence is complete and consistent
branches.then: Allow normal generation with concise evidence linkage.

exceptions: If the task is a pure transformation of already provided text and all required source fields are already attached to the payload, generation may proceed without adding new source inspection.
If the task only rephrases an existing artifact with unchanged factual claims, generation may proceed with provenance preserved.
escalate_when: Evidence conflicts across sources or with requested claims.
References are stale relative to required retention policy.
Required fields remain missing after retry.

change_summary: Governance practice for separating reviewed synthetic public demos from internal test material to prevent data leakage.

body.principle: Public routes must use reviewed synthetic or public-only materials only, while internal, richer corpora stay isolated behind separate controls.
applies_when: Public demos and landing content are prepared.
Website or workflow outputs include proof examples.
do: Use only synthetic or explicitly approved public datasets in any public flow.
Separate and label demo, internal, and restricted corpora.
Document corpus provenance and approval state.
Attach safety checks in workflow preconditions.
avoid: Do not mix restricted internal content into public artifacts.
Do not treat synthetic samples as source of truth for private reporting.
Do not bypass corpus checks to speed publish.
Do not expose internal logs, transcripts, or credentials in demo paths.

checklist.item: Are public artifacts limited to approved synthetic input?
Are private/internal artifacts physically separated in storage/access control?
Is reviewer approval attached to the demo corpus version?
Are boundary changes validated before route activation?

success_signals: Public-facing artifacts remain free of restricted or internal material.
Prepared outputs include provenance labels and approved synthetic proof examples.

change_summary: Portfolio delivery workflow that turns positioning, proof, and architecture inputs into a structured website build handoff with source checks.

body.trigger: Accepted website delivery request with positioning, proof, and target architecture inputs.

inputs.name: request_id
inputs.description: Unique website delivery request identifier.

inputs.name: project_name
inputs.description: Requested site project name.

inputs.name: positioning_notes
inputs.description: Draft positioning and audience focus.

inputs.name: proof_pack
inputs.description: Reviewed proof artifacts to map to sections.

inputs.name: architecture_notes
inputs.description: Technical and content architecture inputs.

inputs.name: delivery_constraints
inputs.description: Brand or implementation constraints from internal standards.

steps.title: Lock scope and ownership
steps.instruction: Capture project owner, audiences, and release constraints.

steps.title: Create handoff brief
steps.instruction: Run a website handoff brief generation pass to structure proof-first hierarchy.

steps.title: Apply source-first gate
steps.instruction: Validate that required evidence and proof links are present before implementation instructions are produced.

steps.title: Define information architecture
steps.instruction: Convert brief sections into ordered page and section map.
steps.output: Site architecture map with section priorities.

steps.title: Map proof to content blocks
steps.instruction: Attach proof_pack items directly to relevant sections and define confidence labels.

steps.title: Set anti-template implementation constraints
steps.instruction: Capture style and anti-pattern rules that prevent generic output.

steps.title: Assemble deliverable package
steps.instruction: Compile handoff files, risks, and quality checks for design/developer handoff.
steps.output: Build handoff package with acceptance checklist.

steps.title: Finalize and route
steps.instruction: Record handoff state and route to designated team with completion criteria.

completion_criteria: Handoff package includes approved content hierarchy.
Proof mapping and anti-template constraints are included.
Readiness status is prepared for implementation handoff.

failure_handling.condition: Required proof_pack or architecture input is missing.
failure_handling.action: Return to requester with explicit dependency gaps and halt delivery.
Escalate to reviewer and stop execution until evidence is corrected.

failure_handling.condition: Acceptance criteria are not satisfied after review.
failure_handling.action: Create correction plan and re-enter from scope lock step.
